priorityList: Use Demon Spikes off-GCD to maintain active mitigation, ensuring it does not cap charges.
Cast Metamorphosis whenever available or if the Untethered Rage proc is active.
Apply Fiery Brand to maintain the Fiery Demise debuff on the target, especially before using major cooldowns.
Cast Reaver's Glaive as soon as the buff is available to begin the Aldrachi cycle.
During the Aldrachi cycle, use Soul Cleave if both Rending Strike and Glaive Flurry buffs are active.
During the Aldrachi cycle, use Fracture if only the Rending Strike buff is active.
During the Aldrachi cycle, use Soul Cleave if only the Glaive Flurry buff is active.
Cast Spirit Bomb if the Fiery Demise debuff is active and you have at least 3 Soul Fragments.
Cast Sigil of Spite if you have 2 or fewer Soul Fragments and Fiery Brand is active or your cooldowns are ready.
Cast Soul Carver if you have 3 or fewer Soul Fragments and Fiery Brand is active or your cooldowns are ready.
Cast Fel Devastation as long as you are not currently in an Aldrachi Reaver buff window (Rending Strike/Glaive Flurry).
Cast Spirit Bomb to spend Soul Fragments when you have 4 or more (3 or more during Metamorphosis or Fiery Brand).
Cast Fracture to generate Soul Fragments if you are below your fragment cap (usually 4-5).
Use Immolation Aura and Sigil of Flame on cooldown to generate Fury and damage.
Use Felblade as a filler for Fury generation and Soul Cleave to dump excess Fury if Spirit Bomb is not needed.
